key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: RADOMUS: Do you really think you can wake her up?
en: RADOMUS: Do you really think you can wake her up?
ja: ラドマス: 本当に彼女を目覚めさせられると思っているのか?

key: NOEL: No, I can't wake her up.
en: NOEL: No, I can't wake her up.
ja: ノエル: いや、僕には目覚めさせられない。

key: She's not asleep.
en: She's not asleep.
ja: 彼女は眠っているわけじゃない。

key: It's a little different.
en: It's a little different.
ja: ちょっと違うんだ。

key: What do you think Dreamsickness is?
en: What do you think Dreamsickness is?
ja: ゆめやみ症が何なのか、わかってる?

key: RADOMUS: Ah, there's less research than I would like,
en: RADOMUS: Ah, there's less research than I would like,
ja: ラドマス: ああ、望むほどには研究が進んでいないが、

key: But in essence, it is the syndrome of those who who gain the ability to alter reality...
en: But in essence, it is the syndrome of those who who gain the ability to alter reality...
ja: 本質的には、現実を変える力を得た者たちの症候群だ……

key: But because reality is inherently homeostatic-- and conservation of energy and all that-- they must sacrifice something in order to make the change.
en: But because reality is inherently homeostatic-- and conservation of energy and all that-- they must sacrifice something in order to make the change.
ja: だが現実というものは本質的に恒常性を保とうとする――エネルギー保存の法則なんかもあってな――変化を起こすには、何かを犠牲にしなければならない。

key: Sometimes it is their consciousness.
en: Sometimes it is their consciousness.
ja: それは時に意識だったり、

key: Sometimes a physical body.
en: Sometimes a physical body.
ja: 時に肉体だったり、

key: Sometimes their presence in the world altogether.
en: Sometimes their presence in the world altogether.
ja: 時にはこの世界における存在そのものだったりする。

key: Some theorize it is like an allergy,
en: Some theorize it is like an allergy,
ja: アレルギーのようなものだ、という説もある、

key: Wherein the physical circumstances become allergic to a person as an irritant.
en: Wherein the physical circumstances become allergic to a person as an irritant.
ja: その人物そのものが刺激物となり、物理的な状況がその人物にアレルギー反応を起こすというわけだ。

key: Therefore, it tries to forcibly remove them for its own health.
en: Therefore, it tries to forcibly remove them for its own health.
ja: だからこそ、自身の健全さを保つために、強引にその人物を排除しようとする。

key: NOEL: I guess.
en: NOEL: I guess.
ja: ノエル: そうかもね。

key: But it's not about the arbitrary concept of 'reality'.
en: But it's not about the arbitrary concept of 'reality'.
ja: でも、「現実」なんていう恣意的な概念の話じゃないんだ。

key: It's about the person themselves.
en: It's about the person themselves.
ja: その人自身の話なんだよ。

key: If you spent less time reading books about it, and more time listening to her instead, you would know that.
en: If you spent less time reading books about it, and more time listening to her instead, you would know that.
ja: 本を読む時間を減らして、その分彼女の話をもっと聞いてれば、わかったはずだよ。

key: RADOMUS: ...I try so hard to chase, that I end up running straight past her,
en: RADOMUS: ...I try so hard to chase, that I end up running straight past her,
ja: ラドマス: ……追いかけるのに必死になりすぎて、結局彼女を追い越して走り抜けてしまう、

key: Is that what you're saying?
en: Is that what you're saying?
ja: そう言いたいのか?

key: NOEL: Or you ran in a different direction entirely.
en: NOEL: Or you ran in a different direction entirely.
ja: ノエル: それか、まったく違う方向に走ってたか。

key: The only thing Anna needed was to feel safe.
en: The only thing Anna needed was to feel safe.
ja: アンナが必要としてたのは、安心できるって感覚だけだった。

key: No one could give that to her, so she made it for herself.
en: No one could give that to her, so she made it for herself.
ja: 誰もそれを与えられなかったから、自分でそれを作ったんだ。

key: Some people are only safe when they're gone.
en: Some people are only safe when they're gone.
ja: いなくなった時にしか安心できない人もいる。

key: She's safe when she's asleep.
en: She's safe when she's asleep.
ja: アンナは眠っている時に安心できる。

key: RADOMUS: But, Lin is no longer a threat...
en: RADOMUS: But, Lin is no longer a threat...
ja: ラドマス: だが、リンはもう脅威ではないだろう……

key: NOEL: I'll let her know that it's safe to come out.
en: NOEL: I'll let her know that it's safe to come out.
ja: ノエル: もう出てきても安全だって、伝えてくる。

key: ANNA: ...Noel?
en: ANNA: ...Noel?
ja: アンナ: ……ノエル?

key: Dad...?
en: Dad...?
ja: お父さん……?

key: ANNA: And... \PN.
en: ANNA: And... \PN.
ja: アンナ: それと……\PN。

key: Good... morning?
en: Good... morning?
ja: お……おはよう?

key: I had... such a weird dream.
en: I had... such a weird dream.
ja: すごく……変な夢を見てた。

key: I dreamt that I was Lin--
en: I dreamt that I was Lin--
ja: あたしがリンだって夢を見て――

key: It was... scary.
en: It was... scary.
ja: それが……怖かった。

key: NOEL: It's okay, Anna.
en: NOEL: It's okay, Anna.
ja: ノエル: 大丈夫だよ、アンナ。

key: It's all over now.
en: It's all over now.
ja: もう全部終わったから。

key: SHIINOTIC: Shiiiiiii?
en: SHIINOTIC: Shiiiiiii?
ja: マシェード: シイイイイ?

key: Shiiii!!!
en: Shiiii!!!
ja: シイイイ!!!

key: SERRA: Nng...
en: SERRA: Nng...
ja: セラ: んん……

key: SERRA: I didn't drink that much, did I...?
en: SERRA: I didn't drink that much, did I...?
ja: セラ: そんなに飲んでなかったはずよね……?

key: SERRA: Oh, it's you...
en: SERRA: Oh, it's you...
ja: セラ: あら、あなたね……

key: I haven't seen you since...
en: I haven't seen you since...
ja: 会うのは、あれ以来ね……

key: The tournament in Labradorra, right?
en: The tournament in Labradorra, right?
ja: ラブラドラのトーナメント以来、よね?

key: Here I thought you were gone forever.
en: Here I thought you were gone forever.
ja: てっきり、もう会えないものだと思ってたわ。

key: SERRA: So, good to see you again and all that...
en: SERRA: So, good to see you again and all that...
ja: セラ: それで、また会えてうれしいわ、とか何とか言うべきなんでしょうけど……

key: But why are you here exactly?
en: But why are you here exactly?
ja: でも、一体どうしてここにいるの?

key: SERRA: ...
en: SERRA: ...
ja: セラ: ……

key: Amendment-- why am I here?
en: Amendment-- why am I here?
ja: 訂正するわ――どうしてあたしがここにいるの?

key: This is Gardevoir's room, isn't it?
en: This is Gardevoir's room, isn't it?
ja: ここ、サーナイトの部屋よね?

key: Er... wasn't it?
en: Er... wasn't it?
ja: ええと……だったわよね?

key: I don't suppose there's any chance she's reappeared, is there?
en: I don't suppose there's any chance she's reappeared, is there?
ja: まさか、彼女がまた現れたなんてことは、ないでしょうね?

key: I'll take a quick look to be sure.
en: I'll take a quick look to be sure.
ja: 念のため、ちょっと見てくるわ。

key: SERRA: What the hell?!
en: SERRA: What the hell?!
ja: セラ: 一体何なのよ?!

key: I'm not still passed out, am I?
en: I'm not still passed out, am I?
ja: まだ意識が飛んだままってことは、ないわよね?

key: LUNA: Mother.
en: LUNA: Mother.
ja: ルナ: お母様。

key: SERRA: What?!
en: SERRA: What?!
ja: セラ: 何よ?!

key: Oh, Luna, it's just you...
en: Oh, Luna, it's just you...
ja: ああ、ルナ、あなたなのね……

key: Geez, you scared me.
en: Geez, you scared me.
ja: もう、びっくりさせないでよ。

key: I have no idea what's going on,
en: I have no idea what's going on,
ja: 何が起きてるのか、さっぱりわからないし、

key: Or where we even...
en: Or where we even...
ja: ここがどこなのかも……

key: SERRA: Wait, Luna?!
en: SERRA: Wait, Luna?!
ja: セラ: 待って、ルナ?!

key: LUNA: I've missed you, Mother.
en: LUNA: I've missed you, Mother.
ja: ルナ: 会いたかったですわ、お母様。

key: SERRA: I--
en: SERRA: I--
ja: セラ: あたし――

key: LUNA: There is no need for alarm, Mother.
en: LUNA: There is no need for alarm, Mother.
ja: ルナ: 慌てる必要はありませんわ、お母様。

key: SERRA: No need for alarm?
en: SERRA: No need for alarm?
ja: セラ: 慌てる必要はない?

key: Last time I saw you, you were gleefully galloping right into a black hole!
en: Last time I saw you, you were gleefully galloping right into a black hole!
ja: 最後に見た時、あなたはブラックホールにうれ々として突っ込んでいったのよ!

key: LUNA: I do apologize for my rather hasty prior exit.
en: LUNA: I do apologize for my rather hasty prior exit.
ja: ルナ: あの、いささか性急な退場については、おわびいたしますわ。

key: But I assure you, I have not regretted it for a moment.
en: But I assure you, I have not regretted it for a moment.
ja: けれど、一瞬たりとも後悔したことはございません。

key: SERRA: Your apologies are almost worse than my son's.
en: SERRA: Your apologies are almost worse than my son's.
ja: セラ: あなたの謝り方、うちの息子よりたちが悪いんじゃない。

key: LUNA: Come with me and I will lead you to safety.
en: LUNA: Come with me and I will lead you to safety.
ja: ルナ: ご一緒に。安全な場所へお連れいたしますわ。

key: I can explain everything along the way.
en: I can explain everything along the way.
ja: 道すがら、すべてご説明いたします。

key: Fine, but I'm not getting off this table unless you promise to explain it in a way that makes sense.
en: Fine, but I'm not getting off this table unless you promise to explain it in a way that makes sense.
ja: いいわ、でも筋の通った説明をするって約束してくれないと、このテーブルから降りないわよ。

key: That means no "darkness darkness infinity" stuff, you hear me?
en: That means no "darkness darkness infinity" stuff, you hear me?
ja: 「闇がどうの、無限がどうの」みたいなやつはナシだからね、わかった?

key: LUNA: Hmm...
en: LUNA: Hmm...
ja: ルナ: うーん……

key: That may prove difficult.
en: That may prove difficult.
ja: それは、少し難しいかもしれませんわね。

key: SERRA: I was just kidding,
en: SERRA: I was just kidding,
ja: セラ: 冗談よ、

key: Mostly.
en: Mostly.
ja: だいたいはね。

key: SERRA: Get me out of here.
en: SERRA: Get me out of here.
ja: セラ: ここから出してちょうだい。

key: LUNA: As you wish, Mother.
en: LUNA: As you wish, Mother.
ja: ルナ: 仰せのままに、お母様。

key: NOEL: ...
en: NOEL: ...
ja: ノエル: ……

key: NOEL: \PN.
en: NOEL: \PN.
ja: ノエル: \PN。

key: I assumed you also...
en: I assumed you also...
ja: 君も一緒だと思ってた……

key: Hm...
en: Hm...
ja: ふん……

key: NOEL: I see.
en: NOEL: I see.
ja: ノエル: そっか。

key: The New World overlapped with here.
en: The New World overlapped with here.
ja: 新世界がここと重なったんだ。

key: We were exploring the place when it happened and became trapped here.
en: We were exploring the place when it happened and became trapped here.
ja: その場所を探索してた時にそれが起きて、ここに閉じ込められたんだね。

key: But it doesn't matter.
en: But it doesn't matter.
ja: でも、どうでもいいことだけど。

key: It's not like this place has any relevance to me.
en: It's not like this place has any relevance to me.
ja: この場所が僕に関係あるわけでもないし。

key: So much for "Father's" castle.
en: So much for "Father's" castle.
ja: 「父さん」の城も、これまでか。

key: I should've expected him to disappear again.
en: I should've expected him to disappear again.
ja: また消えるだろうって、予想しとくべきだったな。

key: NOEL: You got here, so an exit still exists.
en: NOEL: You got here, so an exit still exists.
ja: ノエル: 君がここに来たってことは、出口はまだあるはずだ。

key: I'll find it myself.
en: I'll find it myself.
ja: 自分で見つけるよ。

key: Don't waste time with me.
en: Don't waste time with me.
ja: 僕に時間を使わないでいい。

key: LUNA: I very much appreciate all of your help with the preparation.
en: LUNA: I very much appreciate all of your help with the preparation.
ja: ルナ: 準備のお手伝い、本当に感謝いたしますわ。

key: I do hope that your having spent the effort to assist in serving all of this will not cheapen your own enjoyment of the meal.
en: I do hope that your having spent the effort to assist in serving all of this will not cheapen your own enjoyment of the meal.
ja: お給仕の労を取っていただいたことで、あなた自身のお食事の楽しみが損なわれていなければよいのですが。

key: I suppose some say that food tastes all the more delicious after working hard.
en: I suppose some say that food tastes all the more delicious after working hard.
ja: 頑張って働いた後の食事はより美味しく感じる、と言う人もいますものね。

key: Personally, I find that to be only a small contributing element.
en: Personally, I find that to be only a small contributing element.
ja: 個人的には、それはささやかな要素の一つにすぎないと思いますの。

key: To me, the food tastes best when I can share it with someone else.
en: To me, the food tastes best when I can share it with someone else.
ja: わたくしにとって、食事が一番美味しく感じられるのは、誰かと分かち合える時ですわ。

key: GARDEVOIR: Luna, darling--
en: GARDEVOIR: Luna, darling--
ja: サーナイト: ルナ、あなた――

key: Oh, my word! That smells positively delicious!
en: Oh, my word! That smells positively delicious!
ja: まあ、なんてこと! とてもいい香りだこと!

key: LUNA: Everything is ready.
en: LUNA: Everything is ready.
ja: ルナ: すべて準備できましたわ。

key: Would you see the others in, Gardevoir?
en: Would you see the others in, Gardevoir?
ja: 皆さんをお迎えしていただけますか、サーナイト?

key: GARDEVOIR: On the double!
en: GARDEVOIR: On the double!
ja: サーナイト: すぐに参りますわ!

key: LUNA: ...Ah, perhaps I should have found a proper tablecloth.
en: LUNA: ...Ah, perhaps I should have found a proper tablecloth.
ja: ルナ: ……ああ、ちゃんとしたテーブルクロスを用意すべきでしたわね。

key: Or perhaps not.
en: Or perhaps not.
ja: いえ、これでよいのかもしれません。

key: After everything, I'm simply grateful just to be able to create an evening like this.
en: After everything, I'm simply grateful just to be able to create an evening like this.
ja: 色々あった後だからこそ、こんな夜を用意できることに、ただただ感謝していますの。

key: RADOMUS: Ah, I see you're really putting the facilities to use.
en: RADOMUS: Ah, I see you're really putting the facilities to use.
ja: ラドマス: ああ、この施設を存分に活用しているようだな。

key: That's probably best.
en: That's probably best.
ja: それが一番だろう。

key: LUNA: It would be a true shame to have halls as grand as these, and no one to fill them with.
en: LUNA: It would be a true shame to have halls as grand as these, and no one to fill them with.
ja: ルナ: これほど壮麗な広間があるのに、誰も満たす人がいないなんて、本当に惜しいことですもの。

key: RADOMUS: Anna will be a moment, by the by.
en: RADOMUS: Anna will be a moment, by the by.
ja: ラドマス: ところで、アンナは少し遅れるそうだ。

key: GARDEVOIR: I don't think I'll ever get used to so casually having the endless gaping void just between our doors...
en: GARDEVOIR: I don't think I'll ever get used to so casually having the endless gaping void just between our doors...
ja: サーナイト: 扉と扉の間に、あんな果てしなく口を開けた虚無がさりげなくあるのには、いつまでも慣れそうにありませんわ……

key: Perhaps I should be making more liberal use of my Teleport.
en: Perhaps I should be making more liberal use of my Teleport.
ja: もっと自由にテレポートを使うべきかもしれませんわね。

key: LUNA: Personally, I think it adds a much-deserved bit of charm.
en: LUNA: Personally, I think it adds a much-deserved bit of charm.
ja: ルナ: わたくし個人としては、それがちょうどいい魅力を添えていると思いますの。

key: GARDEVOIR: Well, you would.
en: GARDEVOIR: Well, you would.
ja: サーナイト: ええ、あなたなら言いそうだこと。

key: NOEL: ...That's a lot.
en: NOEL: ...That's a lot.
ja: ノエル: ……すごい量だね。

key: LUNA: It is, perhaps, possible that I've overdone it.
en: LUNA: It is, perhaps, possible that I've overdone it.
ja: ルナ: もしかすると、やりすぎてしまったのかもしれませんわね。

key: But I would not have wished to leave any of you wanting.
en: But I would not have wished to leave any of you wanting.
ja: けれど、皆さんに物足りない思いをさせたくはありませんでしたから。

key: TAKA: Oh.
en: TAKA: Oh.
ja: タカ: あ。

key: Uh, should I really be here?
en: Uh, should I really be here?
ja: えっと、俺、本当にここにいていいのかな?

key: LUNA: Unquestionably.
en: LUNA: Unquestionably.
ja: ルナ: もちろんですとも。

key: Please, take any seat.
en: Please, take any seat.
ja: どうぞ、お好きな席へ。

key: TAKA: Ah, Luna. You've outdone yourself.
en: TAKA: Ah, Luna. You've outdone yourself.
ja: タカ: ああ、ルナ。すごいことになってるな。

key: LUNA: As you know, I live to serve~
en: LUNA: As you know, I live to serve~
ja: ルナ: ご存じの通り、お仕えすることがわたくしの生きがいですもの~

key: SERRA: Did you really do all this by yourself?
en: SERRA: Did you really do all this by yourself?
ja: セラ: これ、本当に一人で全部やったの?

key: And to think I had trouble keeping more than frozen meals on the table...
en: And to think I had trouble keeping more than frozen meals on the table...
ja: あたしなんて、冷凍食品以外をテーブルに並べるだけでも一苦労だったのに……

key: LUNA: Of course it was not all done alone.
en: LUNA: Of course it was not all done alone.
ja: ルナ: もちろん、全部一人でやったわけではありませんわ。

key: \PN set everything here up,
en: \PN set everything here up,
ja: \PNがここのセッティングをしてくれましたし、

key: And I had some help with the cooking as well.
en: And I had some help with the cooking as well.
ja: 料理にも、少し手伝っていただきましたの。

key: Isn't that right?
en: Isn't that right?
ja: そうでしょう?

key: SERRA: Oh.
en: SERRA: Oh.
ja: セラ: あら。

key: Delightful...
en: Delightful...
ja: 素敵ね……

key: RADOMUS: And for what occasion have we gone to all this extent for?
en: RADOMUS: And for what occasion have we gone to all this extent for?
ja: ラドマス: それで、今回はどんな機会にこれほどのことをしたんだ?

key: LUNA: No particular occasion.
en: LUNA: No particular occasion.
ja: ルナ: 特別な機会というわけではありませんわ。

key: Or rather, perhaps the lack of one is exactly why.
en: Or rather, perhaps the lack of one is exactly why.
ja: いいえ、むしろ何もないことこそが理由なのかもしれません。

key: I find it both ideal and necessary to dedicate time and effort to circumstances such as these without requiring the permission of such things like 'occasions'.
en: I find it both ideal and necessary to dedicate time and effort to circumstances such as these without requiring the permission of such things like 'occasions'.
ja: 「機会」などというものの許しを待たずに、こうした時間へ手間と労力をささげること――それこそが理想であり、必要なことだと思いますの。

key: Times are busy, and they get no less so as the days pass.
en: Times are busy, and they get no less so as the days pass.
ja: 時は慌ただしく過ぎ、日を追うごとにそれは変わりません。

key: It is easy for one's priorities to take them apart from those they care for.
en: It is easy for one's priorities to take them apart from those they care for.
ja: 優先すべきことに追われて、大切な人たちから離れてしまうのは容易いことです。

key: As your responsibilities multiply and our hours shorten, is it not best to have someone who,
en: As your responsibilities multiply and our hours shorten, is it not best to have someone who,
ja: 責任が増え、時間が短くなっていく中で、誰かがいてくれるのが一番ではありませんこと、

key: Not only willingly, but with revelry,
en: Not only willingly, but with revelry,
ja: ただ進んでというだけでなく、喜びをもって、

key: Delights in caring for you?
en: Delights in caring for you?
ja: あなたを気にかけることに、心から喜びを見出してくれる誰かが。

key: For many, this person is easily overlooked.
en: For many, this person is easily overlooked.
ja: 多くの人にとって、そういう存在は見過ごされがちですわ。

key: For others, we find it mutually in each other.
en: For others, we find it mutually in each other.
ja: けれど、互いにそれを見出し合える人たちもいます。

key: For myself, I am filled with peace at having the opportunity to be that person.
en: For myself, I am filled with peace at having the opportunity to be that person.
ja: わたくし自身は、その存在になれる機会を得られたことに、心からの安らぎを感じておりますの。

key: I can think of few greater joys than being able to share a heartfelt meal with my family.
en: I can think of few greater joys than being able to share a heartfelt meal with my family.
ja: 家族と心のこもった食事を分かち合えること以上の喜びを、わたくしはほとんど思いつきませんわ。

key: After all, that is exactly what each of you are.
en: After all, that is exactly what each of you are.
ja: 何しろ、あなた方一人一人が、まさにそういう存在ですもの。

key: Bizarre, unconnected, and altogether makeshift,
en: Bizarre, unconnected, and altogether makeshift,
ja: 奇妙で、血のつながりもなく、寄せ集めのような、

key: You are the family I hold dear.
en: You are the family I hold dear.
ja: それでも、あなた方はわたくしの大切な家族ですわ。
